expect_red: the narrowing stages and the relations they may assert are one table, and the cross-part plane null is written out rather than missing

mutations.contract: The cross-part narrowing stage can assert NOTHING about two flat faces, because apps/annotate applies no assembly placement transforms -- every part is drawn at its own local origin, so one mesh's plane normal and offset mean nothing measured against another's. The null in the relation table is a decision with a reason, not a hole.
mutations.note: The mutation fills the null in with the relation it looks like it wants, which is what a reader who has not noticed the missing frame would do. Two planes at unrelated origins then read as parallel or not by accident -- a suggestion that is right half the time, on the one surface in this repo whose value is that it never guesses.
